description: This file defines a custom Android TextView called LogView that implements the LogNode interface. It formats and displays log messages received through the println method, converting log priority levels to readable strings, handling optional exceptions, and appending log entries to the view. It additionally supports chaining to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages in an Android app, implementing the LogNode interface to receive and display log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the LogView; also forwards to the next LogNode in the chain if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
